brief:
Hamas called on the UN Peace Council to halt adopting Israeli accounts and instead focus on ceasefire violations in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The demand followed an article posted by the council's official account on X. Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem delivered the statement in response to the council's public messaging.

The movement has increasingly objected to how international bodies frame developments in the conflict. Hamas argues that the peace council should redirect its attention toward documented breaches of the Gaza ceasefire agreement rather than relay claims originating from Israeli sources. The dispute reflects broader disagreements over which violations and narratives receive international scrutiny during the ongoing hostilities.
